milk.source: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 2.1.2. Current FSSAI Chapter 2.1 dairy compendium checked 03-Nov-2026. Raw cow milk: minimum fat 3.2% m/m and SNF 8.3% m/m. Amendment No. 84 dated 10-Jul-2025 reviewed; draft amendment dated 30-Mar-2026 concerns packaging/labelling cross-reference, not these composition limits. Independent regulatory review pending.
